kitDescription: Liter is a Burst I SMG supporter whose value is team-wide rotation acceleration and buffing rather than personal damage. Each time the team enters Full Burst she shortens every ally's burst-skill cooldown, stepping up with each entry: 2.34s the first time, 2.34+2.7s the second, and the full 2.34+2.7+3.17s from the third entry onward. Each time she fires her own burst she unlocks one more team-wide 5-second buff in a fixed order — first +45.17% max ammo, then also +12.46% crit damage, then also +14.42% ATK — and every previously unlocked layer keeps firing on later casts. Her burst itself grants all allies +66% ATK for 5 seconds, so it lapses about halfway through the 10-second Full Burst window. Her Skill 2 patches the cover HP of the two allies with the most-damaged cover, a purely defensive effect with no damage relevance in the sim.

The S5 structural reds are pure redaction artifacts; its structure-independent event-stream passes are an independent confirmation of the shipped behavior.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA: every kit line is FAITHFUL (both S1 escalating ladders and the burst) or a DOCUMENTED_GAP with an owner ruling (skill2 cover-HP restore, verbatim in unmodeled with a revisit condition). The S5 blind run is RED on paper (8/21) but every failure is reconciled to a de-contamination artifact — the 'escalating' EffectDef union arm was redacted from the blind schema because its comment names Liter, so the blind's structural searches and patch-counterfactuals could not see or touch the nested effects (patches were no-ops producing base-vs-base ties) — plus one durationShots null-vs-undefined event-shape guess; its structure-independent event-stream assertions all PASS and independently confirm the shipped override on every line (cumulative tier counts to all 4 allies, plain-% values, 5s windows, burst target set, skill2 inertness). The S6 blind's two divergences (flat-8.21 CDR, all-buffs-from-cast-1) share the same redaction root cause and its own ⚑ recipes prescribe exactly the driver's encoding; its skill2 heal was self-flagged with the exact removal condition the driver already implements. Discrimination is strong where it matters: the driver's spec pins tier-1 2.34s as exact cooldown arithmetic (comp-independent) and brackets the shipped ladder against all four nearest-wrong ladders (none / flat 2.34 / non-cumulative 3.17 / saturated 8.21), with the two rotation-count discriminations moved to a gauge-rich vehicle after the SMG 24→20 cadence flip made the control comp gauge-bound — a fixture artifact the header documents, not a faithfulness gap. Residual the owner should spot-check (same-model convergence is stability, not proof): (a) the engine's escalating cap semantics min(N,3) — correct here because the kit prints exactly three tiers, but the rule is engine-side and worth one glance; (b) burstCast-vs-fullBurstEnter keying for S1-B is count-degenerate in single-B1 comps and is held by structural + per-cast-frame assertions — a two-B1 fixture would be the only sharper instrument; (c) the cover-HP-does-not-fire-recovery ruling is measurement-gated and documented as such, with a regression pin already in place.
